sourceNotice: 依据 textbook.md 的已核对原文生成；词族和迁移例句为配套拓展。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It's Thursday. The students are doing an art project with old things.
lines.chinese: 星期四，学生们正在用旧物做一个美术项目。

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.english: What did you make with your old things?
lines.chinese: 你们用旧物做了什么？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Look at this toy fish. I made it with a plastic bag and some paper.
lines.chinese: 看看这条玩具鱼。我用一个塑料袋和一些纸做的。

lines.speaker: Billy and Willy
lines.english: What a big fish!
lines.chinese: 好大的一条鱼啊！

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.english: I made this bag with old trousers.
lines.chinese: 我用旧裤子做了这个包。

lines.speaker: Willy
lines.english: How nice!
lines.chinese: 真好看！

lines.speaker: Willy
lines.english: I made this picture with old buttons.
lines.chinese: 我用旧纽扣做了这幅画。

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.english: What a beautiful picture! Your turn, Bobby.
lines.chinese: 多美的一幅画啊！轮到你了，Bobby。

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.english: Oh! What happened?
lines.chinese: 哦！发生了什么？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I made this hat with a cardboard box. But it was rainy this morning.
lines.chinese: 我用一个纸箱做了这顶帽子。但是今天早上下雨了。

lines.speaker: Friends
lines.english: We can help you!
lines.chinese: 我们可以帮你！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Thank you!
lines.chinese: 谢谢你们！

sections.title: Sounds in focus — ur与回收利用歌谣

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Don't burn rubbish.
lines.chinese: 不要焚烧垃圾。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Don't throw it away.
lines.chinese: 不要把它扔掉。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Don't hurt Mother Earth in any way.
lines.chinese: 不要以任何方式伤害地球母亲。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Turn rubbish into something new.
lines.chinese: 把废弃物变成新东西。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Recycle things for me and you.
lines.chinese: 为了你我，回收利用物品。

sections.title: Story time — What a wonderful journey!

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: Hello! I'm a cardboard box.
lines.chinese: 你好！我是一个纸箱。

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: I got here in the morning.
lines.chinese: 我早上来到了这里。

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: What will they do with me?
lines.chinese: 他们会怎么处理我呢？

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: Will they throw me away? Oh no!
lines.chinese: 他们会把我扔掉吗？哦，不！

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: In the afternoon, they picked me up and put me in a recycling bin.
lines.chinese: 下午，他们把我拿起来，放进了回收箱。

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: Then I got on a truck.
lines.chinese: 然后，我上了一辆卡车。

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: There I made friends with plastic cups, plastic bottles and glass bottles.
lines.chinese: 在那里，我和塑料杯、塑料瓶、玻璃瓶交了朋友。

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: The truck took us to a recycling centre.
lines.chinese: 卡车把我们带到了回收中心。

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: The workers there put us into different groups.
lines.chinese: 那里的工人把我们分成不同的组。

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: Then I went into a machine.
lines.chinese: 然后，我进入了一台机器。

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: There I went to sleep. What a long sleep!
lines.chinese: 在那里，我睡着了。这一觉真长啊！

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: Hello again! It's me!
lines.chinese: 又见面了！是我！

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: Now I'm in a library. Yes, I'm a book now!
lines.chinese: 现在我在图书馆里。是的，我现在是一本书了！

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: Children like me very much. How wonderful!
lines.chinese: 孩子们非常喜欢我。多棒啊！

lines.speaker: Cardboard box
lines.english: Next time, I'll become ...
lines.chinese: 下一次，我将变成……
